## 6. Acceptance criteria and stop conditions
Acceptance for closing a gap: (1) no mandatory case omitted: A, B (successor), C each executed on BOTH interpreters; B0 and A0 controls executed on both; (2) NO skip is counted as a pass anywhere; any skip, error or failure is reported as such with its raw output; (3) a gap is "resolved" only for its case as defined above: A resolved iff Q6-A met on both interpreters; B resolved only as a MODIFIED SUCCESSOR CASE (never as the original test passing; the original stays NOT RUN); C resolved iff Q6-C met on both; (4) all raw outputs retained; SHA256SUMS verified.
Stop conditions: (a) tree id, verifier HEAD/engine.py hash, format blob, Registry HEAD, or freeze mismatches the recorded values at run time: stop, record, do not run; (b) a failing test: preserve verbatim, analyse environment vs dependency-version vs genuine implementation counterexample, do not fix, do not retry with different inputs except through a dated amendment that adds (never replaces) a supplementary run; (c) a harness defect (runner/gate/path) is handled only by a dated append-only amendment with the pre-amendment copy and diff; the first attempt remains the record; expectations are never changed; (d) a needed network or write outside the scratch/evidence dirs: stop.
